ei.title: Salt and Water Balance in Sea Creatures
ei.subject: 10월_2025 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Salt and Water Balance in Sea Creatures

fullPassage: Even though sea creatures live in it, they still need to take in water for their bodies to function properly. They just need to get rid of any extra salt it might bring with it. Salt absorbs water like a sponge. If you put a tiny mountain of salt on a small plate, then add enough water to the side, making sure an edge touches the salt, the salt will absorb the water. Now you have a pile of wet salt. Notice that it has increased in size. The same principle applies to sea creatures. If the body fluids in a sea animal are saltier than the seawater it lives in, then the extra salt in the creature's body will absorb seawater. This can cause them to swell up. On the other hand, if the amount of salt in the seawater is higher than the amount of salt in the body fluids of a sea animal, the extra salt in the water will draw fluids out of the creature's body, causing it to dehydrate and shrink.

questions.passage: Even though sea creatures live in it, they still need to take in water for their bodies to (A)[function / malfunction] properly. They just need to get rid of any extra salt it might bring with it. Salt (B)[absorbs / repels] water like a sponge. If you put a tiny mountain of salt on a small plate, then add enough water to the side, making sure an edge touches the salt, the salt will absorb the water. Now you have a pile of wet salt. Notice that it has (C)[decreased / increased] in size. The same principle applies to sea creatures. If the body fluids in a sea animal are saltier than the seawater it lives in, then the extra salt in the creature's body will absorb seawater. This can cause them to swell up. On the other hand, if the amount of salt in the seawater is higher than the amount of salt in the body fluids of a sea animal, the extra salt in the water will draw fluids out of the creature's body, causing it to dehydrate and shrink.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) function=기능하다, (B) absorbs=흡수하다, (C) increased=증가한
det.analysis:
❌ ① function — repels — increased: (B) repels(밀어내다)는 absorbs(흡수하다)의 반의어
❌ ② malfunction — absorbs — decreased: (A) malfunction(오작동하다)은 function(기능하다)의 반의어
❌ ③ function — absorbs — decreased: (C) decreased(감소한)는 increased(증가한)의 반의어
✅ ④ function — absorbs — increased: 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: bodies to function properly / Salt absorbs water / increased in size

questions.passage: Even though sea creatures live in it, they still need to take in water for their bodies to function (A)[properly / improperly]. They just need to get rid of any extra salt it might bring with it. Salt absorbs water like a sponge. If you put a tiny mountain of salt on a small plate, then add enough water to the side, making sure an edge touches the salt, the salt will absorb the water. Now you have a pile of wet salt. On the other hand, if the amount of salt in the seawater is higher than the amount of salt in the body fluids of a sea animal, the extra salt in the water will (C)[inject / draw] fluids out of the creature's body, causing it to dehydrate and shrink.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) properly=적절히, (B) principle=원리, (C) draw=끌어내다
det.analysis:
✅ ① properly — principle — draw: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② improperly — principle — draw: (A) improperly(부적절하게)는 properly(적절히)의 반의어
❌ ③ properly — exception — draw: (B) exception(예외)은 principle(원리)과 의미 다름
❌ ④ properly — principle — inject: (C) inject(주입하다)는 draw(끌어내다)의 반의어
det.tip: function properly / The same principle applies / draw fluids out

questions.passage: Even though sea creatures live in it, they still need to take in water for their bodies to function properly. They just need to get rid of any extra salt it might bring with it. Now you have a pile of wet salt. Notice that it has increased in size. The same principle applies to sea creatures. If the body fluids in a sea animal are saltier than the seawater it lives in, then the extra salt in the creature's body will absorb seawater. This can cause them to (A)[contract / swell] up. On the other hand, if the amount of salt in the seawater is higher than the amount of salt in the body fluids of a sea animal, the extra salt in the water will draw fluids out of the creature's body, causing it to (B)[dehydrate / saturate] and (C)[expand / shrink].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) swell=부풀다, (B) dehydrate=탈수하다, (C) shrink=줄어들다
det.analysis:
❌ ① swell — saturate — shrink: (B) saturate(포화시키다)는 dehydrate(탈수하다)의 반의어
❌ ② contract — dehydrate — shrink: (A) contract(수축하다)은 swell(부풀다)의 반의어
❌ ③ swell — dehydrate — expand: (C) expand(팽창하다)는 shrink(줄어들다)의 반의어
✅ ④ swell — dehydrate — shrink: 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: cause them to swell up / to dehydrate and shrink

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '소금이 물을 흡수하면 크기가 증가한다' 맥락. decreased(감소한)는 increased(증가한)의 반의어

❌ ③ applies — 원문 일치. '같은 원리가 적용된다(applies)'에 적절
❌ ④ swell — 원문 일치. '부풀어 오른다(swell)'에 적절

det.korean: '바다물의 소금이 체액을 빼내어 탈수시킨다' 맥락. hydrate(수분 공급하다)는 dehydrate(탈수하다)의 반의어
det.analysis:

❌ ③ saltier — 원문 일치. '바닷물보다 더 짠(saltier)'에 적절
✅ ④ hydrate — 원문 dehydrate(탈수하다). hydrate(수분 공급하다)로 바꾸면 '수분을 공급하고 줄어든다'는 맥락과 모순 ←정답

❌ ③ (A) 만지다 — (B) 접촉하다: 두 맥락 모두 물리적 의미로 (B)와 불일치
❌ ④ (A) 접촉하다 — (B) 다루다: (B)는 '다루다'가 아닌 '감동시키다'
det.tip: (A) edge touches the salt = 닿다 vs (B) touches the hearts = 감동시키다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to take in liquid gradually through small holes or spaces"

det.analysis:

✅ ② absorb: absorb(흡수하다)는 영영 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답

det.tip: absorb = to take in liquid gradually

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: function → function: to부정사 뒤 동사원형 필요. 'to function properly'
det.analysis: to __________ (function) properly — to부정사 뒤이므로 동사원형 function 그대로 사용

questions.passage: On the other hand, if the amount of salt in the seawater is higher than the amount of salt in the body fluids of a sea animal, the extra salt in the water will draw fluids out of the creature's body, __________ (cause) it to dehydrate and shrink.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: cause → causing: 분사구문으로 결과를 나타내는 현재분사 필요. '~함으로써 탈수와 수축을 야기하다'
det.analysis: __________ (cause) it to dehydrate — 주절 뒤 콤마+분사구문 자리. 결과를 나타내는 현재분사 causing 필요
det.tip: 콤마 + 현재분사(~ing) = 결과 분사구문. causing = ~을 야기하면서

questions.passage: Even though sea creatures live in it, they still need to take in water for their bodies to function properly. They just need to __________ any extra salt it might bring with it. Salt absorbs water like a sponge. If you put a tiny mountain of salt on a small plate, then add enough water to the side, making sure an edge touches the salt, the salt will absorb the water. Now you have a pile of wet salt. Notice that it has increased in size. The same principle applies to sea creatures. If the body fluids in a sea animal are saltier than the seawater it lives in, then the extra salt in the creature's body will absorb seawater. This can cause them to swell up. On the other hand, if the amount of salt in the seawater is higher than the amount of salt in the body fluids of a sea animal, the extra salt in the water will draw fluids out of the creature's body, causing it to dehydrate and shrink.

det.tip: On the other hand = 반면에 (대조 연결어)
